title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: in the 1986 'Analysis situs' notes Grothendieck is trying to axiomatize, purely order-theoretically, the combinatorial data of a 'Λ-special' (resp. 'Λ-pol') situation. The data are (M, ≤, ≪, Λ⊂M, ∥_Λ). M is a set of pieces or strata with an order ≤ and a 'shadow' relation ≪. Λ is a distinguished subfamily. For X∈M, Omb_Λ(X) is the set of shadows of X lying in Λ, and X̃ is an associated subset of M such that Z∈X̃ implies Omb_Λ(Z)⊂Omb_Λ(X). ∥_Λ is a relation on Λ, plausibly parallelism or separatedness. Axiom MΛ4 (p.47) says ∥_Λ is symmetric, antireflexive, and stable under passing to smaller elements (≪). Axiom MΛ2 gives Omb_Λ(X)≠∅.

On p.47 two relations on M are defined from L = X̃∩Ỹ and the 'restrictions to L' X'_L, Y'_L:
• X # Y means: for all shadows X', Y', if X'_L = Y'_L = ∅ then X'∥Y'.
• X ∥_M Y means: X'∥Y' for all X'∈Omb_Λ(X), Y'∈Omb_Λ(Y).

This page (p.48) proves the following.
• Both relations are symmetric. # is reflexive: the hypothesis is never met, since X̃ meets Omb(L) when L = X̃. ∥_M is antireflexive, by antireflexivity of ∥_Λ and nonemptiness of shadows (MΛ2).
• Lemma 1a: X ∥_M Y ⇔ (X # Y and X̃∩Ỹ = ∅).
  – (⇒) # is immediate. If Z∈L, take Z'∈Omb_Λ(Z). Then Z'∈Omb_Λ(X)∩Omb_Λ(Y), so Z'∥Z', contradicting antireflexivity.
  – (⇐) If L = ∅ then Omb(L) = ∅, so every X'_L and Y'_L is empty, and # gives X'∥Y' for all shadows.
• Lemma 1b: on Λ, ∥_M coincides with ∥_Λ, by MΛ4 heredity. So the subscripts are dropped.
• Terminology: for subsets P, Q ⊂ M, P∥Q means X∥Y for all X∈P, Y∈Q. Equivalently, X'∥Y' for all X'∈Omb_Λ(P), Y'∈Omb_Λ(Q), where Omb_Λ(P) is the union of the shadows of the elements of P.

Purpose: build the extended relation ∥ needed for the gluing-type axiom MΛ5 (p.47). That axiom is meant to characterize when such a combinatorial system comes from a genuine Λ-special stratified situation. On p.49 the attempt stalls ('Rien de concret! On oublie!').
errors: Lemma 1b (⇒ direction) tacitly needs X ∈ Omb_Λ(X) for X∈Λ, or an equivalent convention for shadows of elements of Λ. Only heredity under ≪ (MΛ4) is cited.
Lemma 1a (⇒) uses the monotonicity Z∈X̃ ⇒ Omb_Λ(Z)⊂Omb_Λ(X) without stating it. This is presumably part of the definitions on earlier pages (around p.42).
Reflexivity of # is called 'tautological'. It actually requires X̃∩Omb(X̃) ≠ ∅ for every shadow, i.e. again nonemptiness of shadows (MΛ2) plus monotonicity.

ideas.what: Extending a symmetric antireflexive hereditary relation from a subfamily Λ to the whole poset M via 'shadows' (Omb_Λ), and to subsets
ideas.modern_name: Induced or extended relation along a closure/shadow map; a disjointness or separation relation on a poset of strata
ideas.usually_credited_to: no specific attribution; elementary order theory

ideas.what: Lemma 1: X∥Y iff X#Y and X̃∩Ỹ=∅; agreement of ∥_M and ∥_Λ on Λ
ideas.modern_name: Elementary lemma in an axiomatic combinatorial description of tame/piecewise-linear stratifications

ideas.what: Overall program: axioms MΛ0–MΛ5 on a poset with relations characterizing those coming from 'Λ-special' or 'Λ-polyhedral' geometric situations
ideas.modern_name: Combinatorial or axiomatic tame topology (in the spirit of Esquisse 'topologie modérée'); compare combinatorial characterizations of stratified spaces and face posets
ideas.usually_credited_to: tame topology program announced in Esquisse d'un programme (Grothendieck 1984); o-minimal developments by van den Dries and others
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 sketches tame topology in general terms, but not this axiomatics

missed.claim: An attempted purely order-theoretic axiomatization (poset M, shadow relation ≪, subfamily Λ, separation relation ∥) of when combinatorial data arise from a Λ-special/Λ-polyhedral situation. Grothendieck abandons it on the next page because the needed axiom MΛ5 seems too strong.
missed.quote: pour que ça provienne d'une situation Λ-spéciaux, resp. Λ-pol
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: A combinatorial recognition criterion for tame or PL stratified structures is a natural question in tame topology and in combinatorics of face posets. This page only contains routine preparatory lemmas, however, so its value is mainly documentary.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine order-theoretic lemmas inside an axiomatic attempt that Grothendieck himself abandons on the next page. It is of documentary interest for his tame-topology work but contains no substantive new result.
transcription_corrections: The symbol rendered '\not\asymp' on this page is the same relation written '#' (with question mark) on p.47, and likely the '\not\geq' of p.49. It should be transcribed uniformly.
'omb_Λ' and 'Omb_Λ' denote the same operator (lower/upper case varies in the hand).
